Common caveats when swapping synonyms

- Register: Informal vs. formal: “make” vs. “generate.” The choice affects readability but not core meaning.
- Collocations: Not all synonyms fit every sentence. “Generate” is often used for processes, data, numbers, or ideas; “produce” can be more physical or concrete.
